The present detail accident report (DAR) arises out of road accident in which one Laturi Singh, aged about 60 years,
suffered fatal injury resulting in his death.
An application u/s 166 (1) MV Act was also filed by his wife i.e. petitioner Smt.Ramadevi.

victim

Due to the impact, victim fell and sustained injuries.
